text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haaai, goddesses♪ How are we feeling 
today?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You were calling for me, weren't you? I 
could hear your voices.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...So, what is your business with me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
............? That's strange... I could 
have sworn someone called for me...
